bio: On the ground floor of the Verno House hotel sits this bustling city hotspot, where elegantly dressed guests fill the room. Grab a seat on the charming street-side terrace and let the slick team guide you through the globally inspired menu where Hungarian, Japanese, Latin American and Middle Eastern influences collide. The contemporary cooking is full of flavour; the steaks and racks of lamb are real draws – as are their smoking cocktails – and be sure to save room for the nougat babka....
